memory: Everyone checks in the mirror sometimes
tagline: The bathroom light is never kind about it
title: Mirror check
journal: Sometimes the dreams feel so real. I stand there, bathroom light buzzing loudly as I press my face as close to the mirror as I can. I suppose I was looking for a sign, a fragment of the past, I don't see my own image in the glass but a stranger, at first I am scared, but I must remember that I am not what I see, I lift my scalp and bend into the light to remind me I am still here.
prompt: From inside a mirror looking out, a bathroom strip light falls on a cyberpunk android's face as it tilts its head down to study the human brain showing in the top of its open head eyes looking directly at the camera
